args: const fs=require('fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('docs/EVENT_MANIFEST.json','utf8')); const out={}; for(const e of m.events){ const y=(e.historicalDate||'').match(/(20\\d{2})/); const year=y?y[1]:'unknown'; out[year]=out[year]||{count:0,grades:{A:0,B:0,C:0,R:0,other:0}}; out[year].count++; const g=(e.proseGrade||'other'); if(out[year].grades[g]===undefined) out[year].grades.other++; else out[year].grades[g]++; } for(const y of Object.keys(out).sort()){ const r=out[y]; console.log(`${y}\tcount=${r.count}\tA=${r.grades.A}\tB=${r.grades.B}\tC=${r.grades.C}\tR=${r.grades.R}\tother=${r.grades.other}`); }
